subject.title: [Feature]: Add runtime testing for skill workshop proposals before apply

question: What pre-apply runtime validation boundary should Skill Workshop support for pending proposals?
rationale: The useful feature would load or invoke unapproved proposed skill behavior before apply, so automation cannot safely choose the sandbox, tool-policy, network, filesystem, side-effect, and apply-blocking contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Staged smoke gate
options.body: Start with load/discovery/schema validation and record skipped invocation fields until a safe test-case contract exists.

options.title: Full invocation contract
options.body: Design proposal-provided representative inputs, allowed side effects, sandbox policy, and apply override semantics before implementation.

options.title: Defer runtime execution
options.body: Keep static scanning and manual testing for now while tracking the broader lifecycle-contract work separately.

recommendation.title: Staged smoke gate
recommendation.body: Start with load/discovery/schema validation and record skipped invocation fields until a safe test-case contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Shakker introduced the central Skill Workshop proposal store, CLI, and Gateway surfaces that this feature would extend.
